item.stem:
Omar looks at the diagram of $\triangle DEF$. Two interior angles are marked $62^{\circ}$ at $E$ and $49^{\circ}$ at $F$.

Which claim correctly finds the remaining interior angle at $D$?

options.B: Angle $D$ is $62^{\circ}$, the parallel-line measure for this triangle.
options.D: Angle $D$ is $180^{\circ}-62^{\circ}=118^{\circ}$, using only one known interior angle of $\triangle DEF$.
